Created reservation for The Golden Fork on Aug 26 2026 19:00 for 6 guests with contact info; confirmation notification shown and reservation appeared in Upcoming (1) with correct date/time/party size/location.
Cancelled the reservation via Cancel button + confirmation dialog; it was removed from Upcoming (now 0) and appears in Past (1) with status "Cancelled" retaining all details.

Applied WELCOME10 (10% off), removed it, applied GROUP15 (15% off, requires 6+ guests) which was rejected at party size 2 with clear message and accepted at party size 6; final reservation recorded "Coupon applied: GROUP15".

Date picker shows all dates prior to today (Aug 24/25 2026 boundary) as disabled gridcells; future dates are clickable and could be combined with an available time slot (17:00-21:00 in 30 min increments).

issue: Modify reservation dialog does not support changing the date
actual: The "Modify Reservation" dialog only offers "New Time" and "Party Size" fields; there is no control to change the reservation date, so users cannot change the date of an upcoming reservation as required.

issue: Coupon eligibility not re-validated after reservation modification
actual: GROUP15 (requires party of 6+) was applied at 6 guests. After using Modify to reduce party size to 4 guests and saving, the reservation still shows "Coupon applied: GROUP15" even though the party-size eligibility condition is no longer met.

evidence: Submitting with empty Name field triggers native "Please fill out this field" validation; entering an invalid email value triggers "Please include an '@' in the email address" validation message.

Modify dialog opened, time and party size changed and saved successfully with "Reservation Updated" toast; Cancel required an explicit "Cancel Reservation?" confirmation dialog with Keep/Cancel buttons before taking effect.

Creating, modifying, and cancelling reservations each produced an immediate toast notification (Reservation Confirmed!/Reservation Updated/Reservation Cancelled) and the reservations list updated instantly without a page reload.

Upcoming tab shows status "Upcoming"; after cancellation the item moves to Past tab with status "Cancelled". Each card displays restaurant, date, time, party size, status, location (Downtown), and applied coupon.

Submitted a review for Sakura Garden with 4-star rating, name "Timothee I.", visit date Aug 1 2026, and review text; it appeared in the Reviews (2) tab of that restaurant with correct star rating, name, date "Visited Aug 1, 2026" and text. Review was not present on other restaurants' pages (e.g. The Golden Fork).

issue: Review submission not restricted to completed reservations
actual: Navigated directly to a restaurant with no prior reservation of any kind for that restaurant and successfully submitted a review via the "Write a Review" tab; the app does not require or check for a completed reservation before accepting the review, and there is no limit tied to reservation count.

issue: Rating/review count inconsistent between restaurant list and detail page, and not updated by new review
actual: Restaurant list page shows Sakura Garden rating "4.6" while its detail page independently showed "5.0 (1)" before a new review and "4.5 (2)" after submitting a review; the list page rating remained "4.6" and did not update after the new review was submitted, so list and detail summaries are inconsistent and not derived from the same review data.
